title: Detached Object Signature
description: A detached signature over a UAP object. The signing input is the RFC 8785 canonical serialization of the object with the `signature` member removed, prefixed by a domain-separation tag.
$comment: Domain separation binds a signature to one object type. Without it, a signature over a Decision can be replayed as a Bundle whenever the two share a field subset. SPEC.md §4.4 defines the tag set.

kid.description: Key identifier, resolvable in the signer's JWKS at the manifest `keys` URL.

alg.description: Signature algorithm. EdDSA over Ed25519 is REQUIRED to implement; ES256 is OPTIONAL.

value.$comment: Padding is the most frequent cause of cross-implementation signature mismatch.

created.$comment: Verifiers MUST accept any key present in the signer's JWKS at this time, refetching at most once per 60 seconds. Key rotation adds a new kid; it does not invalidate signatures already created.

domain.description: The domain-separation tag prefixed to the signing input.
domain.$comment: Advisory. Verifiers derive the tag from the object type and MUST NOT trust this field.
